project: CLI docs for guards and relationships
description: Add packaged `you docs guards` and `you docs relationships` CLI reference topics with self-contained markdown, index discovery, related-topic cross-links, and CLI tests so factory authors can learn guard and work-item relationship authoring from the installed binary.

context.customerAsk: There is limited documentation on guards. Add new `you docs guards` and `you docs relationships` commands that document how both of those work.
context.problem: Guard and relationship authoring guidance is scattered across internal maintainer guides and partial mentions in existing packaged topics. Guards and relationships are not registered `you docs` topics, so authors cannot print dedicated references from the CLI.
context.solution: Ship two embedded packaged reference pages, register them as `guards` and `relationships` topics, list them in the `you docs` index, replace non-packaged internal cross-links in related CLI docs, and add CLI/docs tests that verify topic output and key sections.

acceptanceCriteria: `you docs guards` prints a self-contained guard reference covering attachment levels, supported guard types, guarded LOGICAL_MOVE loop breakers, and common mistakes.
`you docs relationships` prints a self-contained relationship reference for DEPENDS_ON, PARENT_CHILD, and SPAWNED_BY with batch examples and parent-aware guard linkage.
Bare `you docs` and unsupported-topic errors include the new topics with stable descriptions.
Related packaged topics link to `guards` and `relationships` instead of internal-only doc paths.
CLI and docs package tests verify index listing, topic resolution, and representative content for both topics.
Typecheck, lint, and tests pass for all touched packages

userStories.title: Packaged guards reference and `you docs guards`
userStories.description: As a factory author, I want `you docs guards` so I can choose the right guard type and attachment point without reading internal maintainer guides.
acceptanceCriteria: Running `you docs guards` prints embedded `guards.md` markdown with no index wrapper

Guards page documents workstation-level VISIT_COUNT and MATCHES_FIELDS, per-input SAME_NAME, ALL_CHILDREN_COMPLETE, ANY_CHILD_FAILED, factory inference_throttle_guard, and guarded LOGICAL_MOVE loop breakers with JSON examples
Guards page includes a quick-choice table and distinguishes guards from resources, maxExecutionTime, and maxRetries
Docs package and CLI tests assert guards topic registration and representative sections such as VISIT_COUNT and SAME_NAME
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Packaged relationships reference and `you docs relationships`
userStories.description: As a factory author, I want `you docs relationships` so I can declare batch relations correctly and understand how they affect scheduling and parent-aware guards.

Relationships page explains DEPENDS_ON, PARENT_CHILD, and SPAWNED_BY source/target semantics, optional required_state, batch validation rejection rules, and parent lineage for parent-aware guards
Relationships page includes batch JSON examples and cross-links to packaged guards and batch-inputs topics
Docs package and CLI tests assert relationships topic registration and representative sections such as DEPENDS_ON and PARENT_CHILD
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Docs index and related-topic cross-links
userStories.description: As a factory author browsing packaged docs, I want guards and relationships discoverable from the index and related topics so I do not hit dead internal links.
acceptanceCriteria: Bare `you docs` lists guards and relationships with descriptions and example commands
Unsupported docs topic errors include guards and relationships in the supported-topic list
Packaged workstations, batch-inputs, work, config, and templates pages link to guards and relationships instead of non-packaged internal development paths
